entwurf.thema: Claude Projects: what the free plan includes and what paying adds

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: You keep re-explaining the same background again. Claude Projects can hold that context in one workspace. Is it really free?
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk, rubbing his forehead at a laptop, medium shot, warm evening lamp light.

teile.name: Frage
teile.text: What goes inside? Documents, text, code or other files form its knowledge base. Claude uses them as background for your chats.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center page on projects, shown as a documentation excerpt about uploading documents, text, code or other files to a project's knowledge base.

teile.name: Erklaerung
teile.text: You can define project instructions too, like a more formal tone or a specific role's perspective. Each project keeps its own chats.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket sorts files into separate neat trays on a desk, focused expression, medium shot, cool blue light.

teile.name: Beleg
teile.text: Here's the money part. Projects are available to everyone, including free accounts. Free users can create at most five projects.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center excerpt stating that projects are available to all users including free accounts, with a maximum of five projects for free users.

teile.name: Wendung
teile.text: What does paying add? On paid plans, when knowledge nears context limits, Claude enables RAG mode, expanding capacity up to 10 times.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket stands in a vast archive hall, shelves stretching upward and outward, wide shot, golden light.

teile.name: Aufloesung
teile.text: Those repeated explanations can live in a project, even on free. Paying matters once your files grow large.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket leans back at his desk, calm satisfied expression, laptop open, medium shot, soft cyan and warm lamp light.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket smiles at his tidy desk, medium shot, warm light, calm space above and below.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude Projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chats and knowledge bases, available on free accounts with a limit of five projects. Paid plans expand project knowledge capacity up to 10 times using RAG.
